# testing_oas_format_binary_json (Resource)

OASFormatBinaryJSON Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_format_binary_json" "my_oasformatbinaryjson" {
  content          = filebase64("${path.module}/example")
  name             = "...my_name..."
  optional_content = filebase64("${path.module}/example")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Binary file content, base64-encoded in Terraform configuration
- `name` (String) Name of the resource

### Optional

- `optional_content` (String) Optional binary content, base64-encoded in Terraform configuration

### Read-Only

- `computed_content` (String) Server-computed binary content, only present in responses
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size` (Number) Size of the binary content in bytes

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_format_binary_json.my_testing_oas_format_binary_json
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_format_binary_json.my_testing_oas_format_binary_json "..."
```
